findings.old_conclusion: Zero ordinary soul_scatter HP events implies Soul unavailable on Royal Arrow.
findings.why_incomplete: The observer did not observe SPIRITUAL_HURT_EVENT or the native SHP helper. All 320 historical rows already record SHP loss.
findings.new_conclusion: Native Soul works through the spiritual/SHP path when its own conditions allow. S4: 20 callbacks, 16 native sources, 12 accepted spiritual events, zero ordinary Soul HP events. No production fix.

findings.old_conclusion: Earth projectile exists and scales but its absent native damage event implies boss-path unavailability.
findings.why_incomplete: The old benchmark invokes the inherited empty one-argument collision callback then discards the projectile. The earlier native Earth pre-flight was a real positive control, not invalidated by this later fixture error.
findings.new_conclusion: Natural native ticking reaches the two-argument callback. Same-UUID rescue and untouched native flight work for all five elements; 75 sources, 71 incoming, 46 applied across 90 cases. Nullification and Fire Resistance explain valid denials. No production fix. Only Earth was in the old 320-row matrix.

findings.old_conclusion: 269 absent operations out of 320 indicate a physical/L2 prerequisite collapse; at ES3a its cause remained unresolved.
findings.why_incomplete: Old rows record incoming but lack hurt return and target/world clocks. Incoming does not imply hurt=true. ES3a alone did not prove frozen timers.
findings.new_conclusion: ES3b proves native entity-loop suspension after emptyTime 300 while the scheduler continues. Five new failures return false with frozen invulnerability; one legitimate chunk ticket changes the differential from 15/20 to 20/20. Live full-profile Orc S0/S7 each succeed 10/10. This structurally explains the historical distortion; ZERO of the old 269 rows can be individually assigned by direct timer evidence. No production or L2 fix.

findings.old_conclusion: R3/R4 frequent hurt=false rows demonstrate an inherent high-level Severance physical-admission wall.
findings.why_incomplete: Those diagnostic fixtures lacked a guaranteed ticking entity environment. Their admitted-hit magnitude observations remain historical measurements; their general reliability attribution does not survive R5.
findings.new_conclusion: R5 sustained loaded/ticking delivery admits all 360 Severance arrows and native wound callbacks. The remaining problem is wound magnitude and net progress against native healing, not the claimed intrinsic admission collapse.

findings.old_conclusion: W4 zero actual healing at the native wound ceiling means Regenerate identity was erased and the architecture failed its gate.
findings.why_incomplete: State C has zero legal healing room. Native wound correctly denies the full request there; positive healing must be tested below the ceiling and dynamically.
findings.new_conclusion: P4 rejects the W4 gate as a State-C false negative. P2/P3 preserve native requests/cadence and prove full/partial/zero healing in A/B/C plus strong Regenerate ON defender advantage. This establishes counter-protocol validity only.

findings.old_conclusion: Protocol-valid Candidate C is a candidate for later viability testing, potentially followed by RW calibration.
findings.why_incomplete: Protocol validity and preserving native authority do not establish useful sustained endgame progress.
findings.new_conclusion: V4 rejects and exhausts Candidate C: RW=1 still projects 7.84-7.93 hours HP-only, all ON cases survive, and all 15 cases show zero SHP progress. No authorized RW interval or production implementation remains. Native Severance itself is not rejected.

findings.old_conclusion: Early viability recommendation suggested a high-level threshold such as Lv800 for a future Magic/Holy extension.
findings.why_incomplete: It was a research recommendation preceding actual L2 level/health classification, calibration and production selection.
findings.new_conclusion: Accepted production uses Stage-only S5-S7 Q/RD/RA with an existing initialized L2 attachment and live level/configuration. S0-S4 are no-op; there is no Lv800 activation threshold or TNO persistent level cache. Earlier no-L2-negotiation foundation wording is superseded only for the approved Magic/Holy scope.

findings.old_conclusion: Calibration's gross HP+SHP/DPS estimates could be read as observed practical 5.7-6.7 minute S7 boss kills.
findings.why_incomplete: These were damage-side estimates, not sustained trajectories accounting for healing or proof that unlike resource pools must both deplete.
findings.new_conclusion: P5 validates production damage math and Stage progression. R5 and V4 establish the strong Regenerate limitation in the tested rotation. V4 observed OFF HP deaths with SHP remaining; ON projections are conditional HP-only extrapolations. No fake shared HP/SHP readiness metric is used.

findings.old_conclusion: Historical equal target loss and attacker gain could imply universally conserved equal transfer.
findings.why_incomplete: The original fixture has large attacker capacity/headroom. Native NORMAL gain clamps to available capacity.
findings.new_conclusion: ES2/ES3a capped attackers legitimately gain zero despite target loss; ES3b headroom permits equal gains. Each side follows its own native formula. No extra refund or fallback gain is warranted.
